facts.fact_text: Some of the applications raise an issue concerning the right to freedom of peaceful assembly in connection with the applicants' protests against the landfill site near the town of Klin, Moscow Region.
In March 2018 the applicants started organising protests against the landfill site at Aleksinskiy Quarry.
All the applicants except Ms Kotova (application no. 106/19) were charged with various administrative offences in connection with their protests against the landfill site.

Federal Law no. 7-FZ of 10 January 2002 regulates the protection of the environment in Russia, covering types of polluting entities, the requirement of industrial self-monitoring, the right to information, the right to protest, the right to compensation, and the right to bring complaints.

The right to bring civil or administrative proceedings by private persons or State bodies in respect of environmental damage in Russia is contained in Articles 1064 and 1065 of the Civil Code, Article 23.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences, Articles 39 and 218 of the Code of Administrative Procedure, and Article 42 of the Land Code.
